headline: What Are Starbucks Stock Bulls Not Worried About?
summary: Investors are pricing Starbucks (SBUX) stock at 55.7 times its earnings over the last twelve months, well above the 22.7 multiple for the S&P 500. That premium suggests a bet that U.S. customer visits will keep rising and profit will continue its recovery. The company delivered a fourth straight quarter of comparable sales growth in fiscal Q3 2026. Yet executives used the accompanying earnings call to acknowledge pressure on U.S. consumer sentiment. So what is that pressure.
